description: This file defines a WatchMessagingService class that manages communication between an iOS app and an Apple Watch using WatchConnectivity. It includes error handling, session management, message sending, and delegate methods for receiving messages and state changes.

classes.name: WatchMessagingService
classes.description: A service class managing communication with Apple Watch via WatchConnectivity, including message sending, receiving, and session state management.

methods.name: isSupportedOnDevice
methods.description: Checks if WatchConnectivity is supported on the current device.

methods.name: currentStatusSnapshot
methods.description: Returns a snapshot of the current watch messaging status.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the current watch messaging status.

methods.name: setReplyHandler
methods.description: Sets a handler to process quick reply events from the watch.

methods.name: sendNotification
methods.description: Sends a notification to the watch with specified parameters, handling reachability and queuing if necessary.

methods.name: sendReachableMessage
methods.description: Sends a message to the watch when the session is reachable, using a continuation for async handling.

methods.name: emitReply
methods.description: Invokes the reply handler with a received quick reply event.

methods.name: nonEmpty
methods.description: Trims whitespace and returns nil if the string is empty.

methods.name: parseQuickReplyPayload
methods.description: Parses incoming payloads into WatchQuickReplyEvent objects if they match expected format.

methods.name: ensureActivated
methods.description: Ensures the WCSession is activated, awaiting activation if necessary.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Generates a status object for a given WCSession.

methods.name: activationStateLabel
methods.description: Converts WCSessionActivationState to a string label.
